You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Tram en Ville",
  "slug": "tram-en-ville",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "stage-clear",
  "loop": "Touchez l'écran pour ouvrir les portes quand le tram arrive devant un quai éclairé et faites monter les voyageurs visés par le niveau. Trois quais ratés terminent la partie avec le motif affiché et un bouton pour recommencer.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "chalkboard"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `chalkboard`

# Chalkboard

The game looks sketched in chalk on a school slate.

## Palette

| role   | colour    |
| ------ | --------- |
| slate  | `#2f3e3a` |
| chalk  | `#eeeae0` |
| accent | `#f2c14e` |
| second | `#8fc1e3` |

## Primitives

- Stroked paths with `lineCap = "round"` and a line width of 3 to 5 pixels.
- Draw each stroke twice with a one-pixel offset and lower alpha for a dusty edge.
- Hatching (parallel short lines) instead of solid fills.
- A faint smudge layer: a few large, very transparent chalk-coloured ellipses behind the play field.

## Avoid

- Solid filled shapes larger than a thumb.
- Perfectly straight machine lines; add a small wobble.
- More than two accent colours on screen at once.

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `stage-clear`

# Stage clear

The player meets a stated goal to clear each stage. Clearing the last stage wins; failing a stage loses.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `optional`    |
| level                | `required`    |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `win, lose`   |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: a `level` on entering each stage and an `end` when the play-through finishes. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- Use only `win` or `lose` as the `end` reason. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Stages

Number stages from 1 and step by one. Show the goal on screen when each stage opens ("Light 5 lamps"). Make stage 1 easy enough to clear on the first try.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let stage = 0;
function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  buildStage(stage);
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}
function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
  else enterStage(stage + 1);
}
function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
}
```

Give the player a few seconds of grace at the start of each stage before any threat can finish it.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
Building the full HTML game now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Tram en Ville</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #2f3e3a;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Segoe Print", cursive, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";

let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize() {
  DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---------- palette ----------
const SLATE = "#2f3e3a";
const CHALK = "#eeeae0";
const ACCENT = "#f2c14e";
const SECOND = "#8fc1e3";

// ---------- chalk drawing helpers ----------
function wob(v, amt) {
  return v + (Math.random() - 0.5) * amt;
}

function chalkLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width) {
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineWidth = width;
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.globalAlpha = i === 0 ? 0.85 : 0.35;
    const ox = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
    const oy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.moveTo(wob(x1, 1.5) + ox, wob(y1, 1.5) + oy);
    ctx.lineTo(wob(x2, 1.5) + ox, wob(y2, 1.5) + oy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function chalkRect(x, y, w, h, color, width) {
  chalkLine(x, y, x + w, y, color, width);
  chalkLine(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, color, width);
  chalkLine(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, color, width);
  chalkLine(x, y + h, x, y, color, width);
}

function chalkCircle(cx, cy, r, color, width) {
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineWidth = width;
  const segs = 20;
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = pass === 0 ? 0.85 : 0.35;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
      const a = (i / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * wob(r, 1.5);
      const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * wob(r, 1.5);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function hatch(x, y, w, h, color, count) {
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const t = Math.random();
    const hx = x + t * w;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(wob(hx, 1), wob(y, 1));
    ctx.lineTo(wob(hx + w * 0.08, 1), wob(y + h, 1));
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function chalkText(text, x, y, size, color, align) {
  ctx.font = `${size}px "Comic Sans MS", cursive`;
  ctx.textAlign = align || "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(text, wob(x, 0.8), wob(y, 0.8));
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
  ctx.fillText(text, wob(x + 1, 0.8), wob(y + 1, 0.8));
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// smudges (background)
let smudges = [];
function makeSmudges() {
  smudges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    smudges.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: 60 + Math.random() * 120,
    });
  }
}

function drawSmudges() {
  for (const s of smudges) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.fillStyle = CHALK;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.03;
    ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, s.r, s.r * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ---------- game state ----------
let paused = false;
let running = false; // play started
let gameOver = false;
let stage = 0;
let score = 0;
let misses = 0;
const MAX_MISSES = 3;

const STAGES = [
  { goal: 3, speed: 1.0 },
  { goal: 5, speed: 1.15 },
  { goal: 7, speed: 1.3 },
  { goal: 9, speed: 1.45 },
  { goal: 12, speed: 1.6 },
];

let boarded = 0;
let goal = 0;
let speed = 1;

// tram
let tramX = 0;
let tramDir = 1;
let doorOpen = false;
let doorTimer = 0;

// platform (quai)
let platformLitTimer = 0;
let platformIsLit = false;
let platformCycle = 0;
let stageStartTime = 0;
let graceTime = 2.2; // seconds of grace

let lastTime = 0;

function backToTitle() {
  running = false;
  gameOver = false;
  stage = 0;
  score = 0;
  misses = 0;
  boarded = 0;
  doorOpen = false;
  tramX = -200;
  bootSent = bootSent; // no-op
}

function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  const cfg = STAGES[stage - 1];
  goal = cfg.goal;
  speed = cfg.speed;
  boarded = 0;
  tramX = -220;
  tramDir = 1;
  doorOpen = false;
  doorTimer = 0;
  platformIsLit = false;
  platformCycle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  stageStartTime = performance.now();
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}

function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) {
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: score });
    gameOver = true;
    winFlag = true;
  } else {
    enterStage(stage + 1);
  }
}

function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
  gameOver = true;
  winFlag = false;
}

let winFlag = false;

// passengers waiting on platform, little chalk stick figures
let passengers = [];
function spawnPassengers() {
  passengers = [];
  const n = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    passengers.push({ ox: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40 });
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
let bootSent = false;

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    gameOver = false;
    score = 0;
    misses = 0;
    spawnPassengers();
    enterStage(1);
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  if (gameOver) {
    // restart soft
    running = false;
    return;
  }
  act();
});

function act() {
  // try to open doors: only succeeds if tram is centered AND platform lit
  const centerX = W / 2;
  const nearCenter = Math.abs(tramX - centerX) < 55;
  if (nearCenter && platformIsLit && !doorOpen) {
    doorOpen = true;
    doorTimer = 0.9;
    const boardCount = Math.min(passengers.length, 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2));
    boarded += boardCount;
    score += boardCount;
    CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    spawnPassengers();
    if (boarded >= goal) {
      setTimeoutSafe(() => onGoalMet(), 500);
    }
  } else if (nearCenter && !platformIsLit) {
    // missed attempt: tapped when platform not lit -> counts as fail attempt only if door already passed
    misses += 1;
    if (misses >= MAX_MISSES) {
      setTimeoutSafe(() => onStageFailed(), 200);
    }
  }
}

// safe setTimeout wrapper using function refs (already fine, but centralize)
function setTimeoutSafe(fn, ms) {
  window.setTimeout(fn, ms);
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (!running || paused || gameOver) return;

  const elapsed = (performance.now() - stageStartTime) / 1000;
  const inGrace = elapsed < graceTime;

  // tram movement: goes across screen, slows near center, then continues
  const centerX = W / 2;
  const speedPx = speed * 90;
  tramX += tramDir * speedPx * dt;

  if (tramX > W + 250) {
    tramX = -220;
    // missed a full pass without boarding attempt while lit -> minor consequence not counted separately
  }

  // door auto closes
  if (doorOpen) {
    doorTimer -= dt;
    if (doorTimer <= 0) {
      doorOpen = false;
    }
  }

  // platform lighting cycles, but not during grace period at stage very start (give a lit window early)
  platformCycle += dt * (1.1 + speed * 0.3);
  const litWindow = Math.sin(platformCycle) > 0.55;
  platformIsLit = inGrace ? true : litWindow;

  // detect tram passing center while NOT lit and NOT boarded this pass -> could fail;
  // simplified: handled at tap. Also add slow drift failure if too many stage-loops without goal.
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = SLATE;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawSmudges();
  chalkText("Tram en Ville", W / 2, H * 0.32, Math.min(48, W * 0.09), CHALK);
  chalkText("Touchez l'écran pour ouvrir les portes", W / 2, H * 0.44, Math.min(20, W * 0.045), SECOND);
  chalkText("quand le quai s'éclaire, pour faire monter", W / 2, H * 0.44 + 26, Math.min(20, W * 0.045), SECOND);
  chalkText("les voyageurs visés par le niveau.", W / 2, H * 0.44 + 52, Math.min(20, W * 0.045), SECOND);

  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  chalkText("Touchez pour commencer", W / 2, H * 0.7, Math.min(26, W * 0.06), ACCENT);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  drawTramSprite(W / 2, H * 0.85, false, 1);
}

function drawTramSprite(cx, cy, lit, scale) {
  const w = 160 * scale, h = 60 * scale;
  const x = cx - w / 2, y = cy - h / 2;
  chalkRect(x, y, w, h, CHALK, 4);
  // windows
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    chalkRect(x + 12 + i * (w / 3), y + 10, w / 3 - 24, h * 0.4, SECOND, 3);
  }
  // wheels
  chalkCircle(x + 25, y + h + 4, 10, CHALK, 3);
  chalkCircle(x + w - 25, y + h + 4, 10, CHALK, 3);
  // pantograph line
  chalkLine(cx, y, cx, y - 20, CHALK, 3);
  if (lit) {
    chalkCircle(x + w / 2, y - 4, 6, ACCENT, 3);
  }
}

function drawPlatform() {
  const py = H * 0.62;
  const glow = platformIsLit;
  // platform slab
  chalkLine(W * 0.1, py, W * 0.9, py, CHALK, 5);
  chalkLine(W * 0.1, py + 14, W * 0.9, py + 14, CHALK, 4);
  hatch(W * 0.1, py, W * 0.8, 14, CHALK, 18);

  // lamp post
  const lampX = W * 0.5;
  chalkLine(lampX, py - 90, lampX, py, CHALK, 4);
  chalkCircle(lampX, py - 96, 14, glow ? ACCENT : CHALK, 4);
  if (glow) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.fillStyle = ACCENT;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
    ctx.arc(lampX, py - 96, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // waiting passengers - stick figures
  passengers.forEach((p, i) => {
    const px = W * 0.5 + p.ox + (i - passengers.length / 2) * 22;
    const pyFeet = py - 2;
    chalkCircle(px, pyFeet - 34, 7, CHALK, 3);
    chalkLine(px, pyFeet - 27, px, pyFeet - 8, CHALK, 3);
    chalkLine(px, pyFeet - 8, px - 6, pyFeet, CHALK, 3);
    chalkLine(px, pyFeet - 8, px + 6, pyFeet, CHALK, 3);
    chalkLine(px, pyFeet - 20, px - 8, pyFeet - 10, CHALK, 3);
    chalkLine(px, pyFeet - 20, px + 8, pyFeet - 10, CHALK, 3);
  });
}

function drawHUD() {
  chalkText(`Niveau ${stage}`, 70, 30, 20, CHALK, "left");
  chalkText(`Objectif: ${boarded}/${goal}`, 70, 56, 18, ACCENT, "left");
  chalkText(`Score: ${score}`, W - 70, 30, 20, CHALK, "right");
  // misses as chalk marks
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_MISSES; i++) {
    const mx = W - 40 - i * 26;
    const my = 56;
    const active = i < misses;
    chalkCircle(mx, my, 8, active ? SECOND : CHALK, 3);
  }
  const elapsed = (performance.now() - stageStartTime) / 1000;
  if (elapsed < graceTime) {
    chalkText("Préparez-vous...", W / 2, 90, 18, SECOND);
  }
}

function drawGame() {
  ctx.fillStyle = SLATE;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawSmudges();

  drawPlatform();

  const tramY = H * 0.62 - 40;
  drawTramSprite(tramX, tramY, doorOpen, 1.1);

  if (doorOpen) {
    chalkText("Portes ouvertes !", tramX, tramY - 60, 16, ACCENT);
  }

  drawHUD();

  if (paused) {
    ctx.fillStyle = SLATE;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    chalkText("Pause", W / 2, H / 2, 40, CHALK);
  }
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = SLATE;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawSmudges();

  if (winFlag) {
    chalkText("Terminus atteint !", W / 2, H * 0.35, 34, ACCENT);
    chalkText("Bravo, tous les quais sont desservis.", W / 2, H * 0.45, 18, CHALK);
  } else {
    chalkText("Trois quais ratés...", W / 2, H * 0.35, 32, SECOND);
    chalkText("Le tram repart sans vous.", W / 2, H * 0.45, 18, CHALK);
  }
  chalkText(`Score final: ${score}`, W / 2, H * 0.53, 20, CHALK);

  // draw a simple button
  const bw = 220, bh = 60;
  const bx = W / 2 - bw / 2, by = H * 0.65;
  chalkRect(bx, by, bw, bh, ACCENT, 4);
  chalkText("Rejouer", W / 2, by + bh / 2, 22, CHALK);

  if (!restartHooked) {
    restartHooked = true;
  }
}

let restartHooked = false;

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  if (!gameOver) return;
  const bw = 220, bh = 60;
  const bx = W / 2 - bw / 2, by = H * 0.65;
  const x = event.clientX, y = event.clientY;
  if (x >= bx && x <= bx + bw && y >= by && y <= by + bh) {
    backToTitle();
  }
});

// ---------- main loop ----------
function frame(t) {
  if (!lastTime) lastTime = t;
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (t - lastTime) / 1000);
  lastTime = t;

  if (!smudges.length) makeSmudges();

  if (!paused) {
    update(dt);
  }

  if (!running) {
    drawTitle();
  } else if (gameOver) {
    drawGameOver();
  } else {
    drawGame();
  }

  if (!bootSent) {
    bootSent = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Tram en Ville", gameType: "stage-clear", lang: "fr" });
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

tramX = -220;
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
